Title: Public preview: Visual Studio Code extension for Azure Container Apps

Body.Content:
Azure Container Apps is a service for building and deploying modern applications and microservices using serverless containers. A Visual Studio Code extension is now available in public preview for Azure Container Apps.

With this initial release of the Container Apps Visual Studio Code extension, you can deploy apps from a container image and manage them directly from Visual Studio Code.

Learn more.
